caseNames: derives across objects update in the batch of the commit that changed their source's object
the pull model computes a diamond's derives once each per batch
the pull model leaves unwatched derives dirty until read; a one-off read does not make them eager
the pull model diffs a watched derive's old and new value (counted), and sends no frame when they are equal
a watched derive read between two changes of its source in one batch delivers one frame: its last value, diffed from the value before the batch (one diff)
a watched derive read between two changes of its source in one batch delivers nothing when the batch ends at the value it started from
a watched derive read between two changes of its source in one batch a derive over it is one frame too, read or not
a watched derive read between two changes of its source in one batch a failure read in between and the value after it are one frame, the diff from the value before; no failure call
a watched derive read between two changes of its source in one batch a value read in between and the failure after it are one failure call
failures give the throwing derive's watches and those of the derives over it one failure call; they heal on a later change
failures give one failure call per episode: a recompute that throws again is quiet; a heal ends the episode
failures open a new watch on a failed derive at its last good value, the failure its first call, then the heal
failures report once per failure episode, also when nothing watches (a lazy derive fails when read)
failures fold a failure and a value for a busy listener: the value replaces the failure, as a root replacement
GC a detached derive is not held by its former sources
GC a watch open on a failed derive keeps nothing more: it ends with its reference, and a retained one holds no source
GC of handed-out errors a failure call's fresh error kept by its listener keeps nothing of its host once the host closes
mapShared maps an object element once while it stays the same object; primitives every time
mapShared keeps no element alive in its cache
mapShared returns the previous result object for an unchanged element
the retired flag a derive over a retired source publishes retired: true although its value and ops are unchanged (rule 21)
the retired flag a retirement while the derive is failed travels with its next good value
the retired flag a retirement visits each derive of a diamond once, not once per path (40 derives)
